newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen up on technical rebound.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen up on technical rebound.

text.p: Thai stocks were expected to gain slightly on a technical rebound on Friday after declining sharply on Thursday, brokers said.

"The index is expected to rise marginally today on a technical rebound. Yesterday's fall was due to psychological concerns among investors rather than from fundamentals in the market," said Thanawat Patchimkul of Seamico Securities.
The composite SET index fell 15.13 points to 701.76 on 2.96 billion baht turnover on Thursday. The SET-50 index closed 0.50 point lower to 53.48.
The SET index ended 2.11 percent lower on Thursday as investors unloaded shares of ailing Bangkok Bank of Commerce Plc, spurring sales of bank stocks and depressing the market.
Brokers said turnover was expected to remain thin on Friday as investors were waiting for first quarter earnings of finance companies which are due next week.
